item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.

turns.text: Can you make a thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better? This is a habit I've struggled with myself, so the topic feels pretty personal to me. I mean one 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, and I'd like you to choose a punchy headline that's exactly three words in English. Please invent a tired-looking person for it, with their age, appearance and placement up to you, but make the face big. I'm a little worried about it getting lost among all the other thumbnails people see. Make it easy to read on a phone; the style, colours and layout are your call, and free-tier resolution is fine.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the thumbnail because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

Here’s the design I chose:
- **Headline:** “STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT” — exactly three words.
- **Layout:** Huge yellow lettering on the left; a large, fictional tired-looking adult face on the right.
- **Style:** Dark navy background, blue phone light, and warm bedside lighting—high contrast and minimal clutter for readability on a phone.
- **Format:** One 16:9 thumbnail at free-tier 640px resolution.

Once credits are available, I can retry this design.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create one polished, punchy 16:9 YouTube thumbnail about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better, composed to be instantly readable on a small mobile screen. EXACT visible English headline, exactly three words: STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT. Set headline on the LEFT 57% in three stacked lines: STOP / SCROLLING / TONIGHT. Very large heavy condensed sans-serif uppercase, crisp clean correct spelling, bright warm yellow with strong dark outline and subtle shadow against nearly black navy. Keep generous safe margins and no other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. On the RIGHT: an entirely fictional adult approximately 32 years old, short messy dark hair, medium skin tone, tired expressive eyes with subtle dark circles, relatable weary but determined expression, looking toward viewer. Face very large, filling most of the right half from forehead to chin, realistic editorial photographic quality, natural skin texture. A smartphone held near the lower right edge casts electric blue light upward on their face; no readable phone screen text. Deep navy bedroom background kept extremely simple, soft pillow silhouette and a warm amber bedside glow suggesting better sleep. Dramatic cool blue versus warm yellow/amber lighting, high contrast, clear silhouette, minimalist uncluttered composition, strong visual hierarchy, emotional authentic self-improvement tone rather than horror or shaming. Face and text must not overlap. Prioritize huge legible headline and huge expressive face over decorative details.
